notes.title: Closed Beta Version 1.1.1 Build Notes
notes.notes:
New features and fixes:

 Added a 3-second countdown sound effect in the Discography Shop!
 The timer in the Discography Shop now becomes RED when during the final 5 seconds
 Added a 10-second 2wrning sound effect in the Discography Shop!
 Reduced the number of prop cards in the card pools.
 Fixed how tooltips are displayed when a playing in Window mode
 Now there are 3 different new tutorials uploaded! Hover over the ‘Tutorial’ button on the main screen to see the options
 Added helpful text to every screen of the ‘Build/Edit band’ module’
 Fixed the displaying of Empty players’ slots in the Battle Lobby screen
 Added helpful text to the Staging screen
 Updated Managers’ descriptions in the Shop module
 Purchased items no longer disappear from the Shop; instead, you will see them as ‘Owned’
 Added info buttons to all in-game character cards. Hover over the ‘i’ button in the Shop on Managers/Band Members cards to see their details!
 Updated resizing logic in Window mode so it resizes correctly and no longer jitters.
 Adjusted Band Manager sprites
 Updated Round Result (Wrap Up) screen


Known Issues and bugs:

 When the player joins the lobby, then leave it, and immediately joins again - he will see 2 instances of himself, it is not a bug, it is game logic, so the game creates ghost players when someone leaves the lobby/match
 At low specs PC, the game could have not enough time to load all the data, so the cases when players have some empty screens or blocks without text are OK
 Aria modules don’t disappear at the victory screen
 AVAST/AVG flags the .exe of the game as a virus
 Some abilities cards name text is too long and it overlaps with the logo
 In some very specific cases, the shield can remain on stage from the previous round
 Issues with Bella and sweet zombie ultimate camera movement. Bella camera angle is incorrect and the sweet zombie camera doesn't trigger
 Some members animations have clipping
 Sometimes in very specific cases after the enemy knocking the Bit Render - he starts floating
 The music stops playing after the player hit ‘READY’ button

notes.title: Closed Beta Version 1.0.3 Build Notes
notes.notes:
New features and fixes:

Updated ‘winning’ text, now you will see ‘You WIN’ when you win, and ‘*opponent’s name* WINS’ when your opponent wins
 The leaderboard (Round result) screen now shows the total amount of fame of each player
 UI for ‘START MATCH’ and ‘EDIT BAND’ buttons is adjusted, now they are more noticeable
 Fixed audio glitches between 2 consistent Ultimate Attacks
 Challenges start date is fixed, now it will start counting from when the player first opens the game
 Placeholders bug in Round result screen is fixed 
 The crash window that pop-ups every time player closed the game - is fixed
 Band statistics logic is fixed
 Implemented 25 Steam Achievements - go get them all!
 Now players can see the Manager level on the Rewards screen
 The size of places’ numbers on the Match result screen is fixed
 ‘Round’ font is fixed
 Staging Fill Bar is fixed
 Some outdated design is removed from Discography Shop
 Updated sprites for 'Atmosphere Icon' + 'Fame icon'
 UI small fixes
 Added Atmosphere filter for band members due to Band Manager atmosphere


Known issues:

 When the player joins a lobby, then leaves, and immediately joins again there will be 2 instances of that player
 Low spec PCs may not have enough time to load all data, creating some empty screens or blocks without text
 Aria modules don’t disappear at the victory screen
 AVAST/AVG flags the .exe of the game as a virus
 Minor localization issues
 Sometimes the player can experience the wrong level portrait in the Round result / Lobby screen
 Categories order in ‘Build’ module
 Some ability names are too long and overlap the logo
 'Crash' window opens after the player hitting 'Exit' or 'X after playing the match
 In some very specific cases, the shield can remain on stage from the previous round
 Issues with Bella and Sweet Zombie’s ultimate camera movement. Bella’s camera angle is incorrect and Sweet Zombie’s camera doesn't trigger
 Some band member animations have clipping 
 Placeholders sometimes appear in the 'Lobby' screen
 Sometimes in very specific cases after knocking out Bit Render - he starts floating
 Sometimes the player can experience the wrong level portrait in the Rewards screen
 Video tutorial pop-up design is not updated
 The separator between rounds numbers is missing at the Match result screen

notes.title: Closed Beta Version 0.9.4 Build Notes
notes.notes:
New features and fixes:

 Added a Discord panel. For additional communication, use the button to join the AudioClash beta Discord server
 Apollyon song abilities rebalanced
 Paradise Forest song abilities rebalanced
 Beyond Quasars song abilities rebalanced
 Rebalanced all band member stats to have a better separation of Atmospheres
 Tormentor Atmosphere band members focus on attack power
 Maverick Atmosphere band members focus on increasing health
 Dynamo Atmosphere band members focus on more fame
 Blank abilities now have text indicating they increase band member stats
 READY button added to the Staging screen. Click it when you've placed your band members on stage!
 Implemented Tooltips system 
 Updated song pop-up UI
 Updated filters UI
 Updated screen UI
 Updated screen logic
 Updated rewards screen
 Updated challenge screen UI
 Updated navigation menu panel UI
 Updated button UI
 Mascots were adjusted 
 Fixed first screen animation displaying while launching the game in window mode (Removed parallax effect from splash screen)
 Updated Steam payments system
 DOC was adjusted -> Now he attacks only 1 opponent 
 DOC sound effect was adjusted
 New Guest Stars audio stems are implemented
 Small visual bugs are fixed
 Small UI tweaks were done
 Added new stage design
 Settings pop-up screen was updated
 Fixed a case when players experienced an infinite loop
 If you experience a bug, performance issue, or have a suggestion, please submit a short description by using the “Report bug” option in the Settings menu. Click the gear icon on the main menu to open settings


Known issues:

 Sometimes an empty screen appears after launching the game
 Low spec PCs may not have enough time to load all data, creating some empty screens or blocks without text
 Tooltips have some bugs (when hovering at the end of some screen timer)
 There is an incorrect tooltip in the build module
 Tooltip trigger zones should be adjusted
 Tooltip ‘Sell this ability for...’ remains on screen after selling an ability
 Some Guest Stars and some band member attacks do nothing (no animation or damage given) in cases where all opponents are KO'd
 Aria modules don’t disappear at the victory screen
 AVAST flags the .exe as virus
 Minor localization issues
 Players from previous matches could be displayed in the Lobby Screen when the player launches another match
 Sometimes the player could get trapped in a loop at the end of the round
 Order of gems in ‘buy gems’ pop-up is incorrect
 Categories order in ‘Build’ module
 Some ability names are too long and overlap the logo
 'Buy Gems’ pop-up UI is not updated
 ‘Tutorial’ button opens empty screen, it should be removed
 Some hover-Over states are missing
 'Crash' window opens after hitting 'Exit' or 'x' after playing the match
